{"consolidated_memory":"## Crash Loop Issues in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml (3 Separate Occasions)

**Common Pattern:** All three incidents involved crash loops in the deployment, reproducible by rolling out to the small node pool, with the signal being a container restarting a few seconds after start. Stack is YAML; covering check is manifest lint and dry run in CI.

### Occasion 1: 2026-02-04 - Cache Invalidation Bug
- **Trigger:** Staging read replica only
- **Root Cause:** Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- **Fix:** Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction (PR #7953, branch fix/crash-loop-2)
- **Outcome:** p99 latency fell from 8.7 s to 614 ms

### Occasion 2: 2026-03-05 - Race Condition in Lazy Initialization
- **Trigger:** Only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- **Root Cause:** Race in lazy initialisation
- **Fix:** Guarded the init with a double-checked lock (PR #9448, branch fix/crash-loop-3)
- **Outcome:** Cold start dropped 2 percent, to 776 ms

### Occasion 3: 2026-08-26 - Listener Not Removed on Teardown
- **Trigger:** Only when the input list came in empty
- **Root Cause:** Listener registered but never removed
- **Fix:** Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #9480, branch fix/crash-loop-4)
- **Outcome:** Memory settled at 844 MB instead of climbing past 1 GB"}
